claim: In the European MORE registry of routine ANT-DBS (170 eligible), 41% were responders (>=50% reduction) at last follow-up (median 3.5 y); 5-year completers' median monthly seizures fell from 16 to 7.9.

bibliographic_record.authors: Kaufmann E, Peltola J, Colon AJ, Lehtimäki K, Majtanik M, Mai JK, Bóné B, Bentes C, Coenen V, Gil-Nagel A, Goncalves-Ferreira AJ, Ryvlin P, Taylor R, Brionne TC, Gielen F, Song S, Boon P, MORE study group.
bibliographic_record.title: Long-term evaluation of anterior thalamic deep brain stimulation for epilepsy in the European MORE registry.
